channel.title: Texas Legislature - Today's Filed Bills in the House

item.title: HB 1283 Introduced

item.title: HB 1284 Introduced

item.title: HB 1285 Introduced

item.title: HB 1286 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Gervin-Hawkins

item.title: HB 1287 Introduced

item.title: HB 1288 Introduced
